identificationModule.briefTitle: Surufatinib Combined With Toripalimab and Chemotherapy in the Treatment of Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Open-label, Single Center, Phase II Study of Surufatinib Combined With Toripalimab and Chemotherapy in Patients With Advanced Non-squamous Non-small-cell Lung Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A phase II study to assess the efficacy and safety of Surufatinib Combined With Toripalimab and Chemotherapy in patients with advanced non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer.

armGroups.label: Patients without targetable driver mutations
armGroups.description: Patients with advanced non-squamous NSCLC negative for canonical driver genes except KRAS

armGroups.label: Patients with targetable driver mutations
armGroups.description: Patients with advanced non-squamous NSCLC harboring actionable genomic alterations

interventions.name: Surufatinib, Toripalimab, Pemetrexed, Carboplatin/Cisplatin
interventions.description: Surufatinib at the dose determined in phase safety lead-in, 250 mg, qd, po, every 3 weeks (q3w); Toripalimab at the dose 240mg, iv, d1, q3w; Pemetrexed at the dose 500 mg/m2, iv, d1, q3w; Carboplatin at the dose AUC=5\~6, iv, d1, q3w or Cisplatin at the dose 75 mg/m2, iv, d1, q3w; Maintenance treatment: After the end of the first-line treatment, patients with CR, PR, and SD can continue to maintenance treatment with Surufatinib RP2D + Toripalimab 240mg, d1, q3w + Pemetrexed 500mg/m2, d1, q3w. Treatment continues until disease progression, death, or intolerable toxicity occurs.

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of first dose of study drug until disease progression, withdrawal of consent, death, new anticancer therapy (up to 24 months)

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of first dose of study drug until disease progression, withdrawal of consent, death, new anticancer therapy (up to 24 months)
From date of first dose of study drug until disease progression, withdrawal of consent, death, new anticancer therapy (up to 24 months)
From date of first dose of study drug until withdrawal of consent or death (up to 36 months)
From date of first dose of study drug until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 12 months

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of patients suffering adverse events (CTCAE 5.0)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of signing the informed consent form until survival follow-up or initiation of new anti-tumor therapies (up to 36 months).
